description: This file is a shell script used for testing git archive attribute patterns. It sets up a repository with various attributes and directories, then tests whether files are correctly included or excluded in a git archive based on their attributes and patterns.

methods.name: test_expect_exists
methods.description: Checks that a specified file exists.

methods.name: test_expect_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specified file does not exist.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the tests.
